description: This file defines a set of debug actions as a static enum 'DebugActions' for a macOS application. It includes functions to open various windows, log files, perform health checks, restart processes, toggle verbose logging, and manage sessions and ports, primarily for debugging and development purposes.

methods.name: openAgentEventsWindow
methods.description: Opens a window titled 'Agent Events' with a SwiftUI view.

methods.name: openLog
methods.description: Opens the log file in the Finder if it exists.

methods.name: openConfigFolder
methods.description: Opens the configuration folder in the Finder.

methods.name: openSessionStore
methods.description: Opens the session store file or its containing folder.

methods.name: sendTestNotification
methods.description: Sends a test notification.

methods.name: sendDebugVoice
methods.description: Sends a debug voice command and returns success/failure.

methods.name: restartGateway
methods.description: Restarts the gateway depending on the connection mode.

methods.name: resetGatewayTunnel
methods.description: Resets the SSH tunnel in remote mode.

methods.name: pinoLogPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the log file.

methods.name: runHealthCheckNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate health check.

methods.name: sendTestHeartbeat
methods.description: Sends a test heartbeat event.

methods.name: verboseLoggingEnabledMain
methods.description: Boolean indicating if verbose logging is enabled.

methods.name: toggleVerboseLoggingMain
methods.description: Toggles verbose logging setting.

methods.name: restartApp
methods.description: Restarts the app by relaunching itself.

methods.name: restartOnboarding
methods.description: Restarts the onboarding process.

methods.name: resolveSessionStorePath
methods.description: Resolves the session store file path based on config or default.

methods.name: recentSessions
methods.description: Loads recent session entries.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates a session with new thinking and verbose levels.

methods.name: checkGatewayPorts
methods.description: Diagnoses port status for the gateway.

methods.name: killProcess
methods.description: Kills a process by pid, with force option if needed.

methods.name: openSessionStoreInCode
methods.description: Opens the session store file in Visual Studio Code.
